subjects.subject: Math & Logic
subjects.infoText:
Formulas:

Addition: 'add, get, take' a + b

Subtraction: 'subtract, remove, give' a - b

Multiplication: 'multiply', a * b

Division: 'divide', a / b

a < b means b is greater

a > b means a is greater

subjects.subject: English Grammar
subjects.infoText:
Noun: Person/Place/Thing

Verb: An action

Adjective: Describes a noun

Plurals:

Add 's' to most words

For words ending in 'y', change the 'y' to 'ies'

Add 'es' for words ending in 'x'

Past Tense: Add '-ed' to regular verbs

subjects.subject: Environmental Science
subjects.infoText:
Recycling: Plastic, paper

Precipitation: Falls from the sky (snow, rain, hail)

Habitats: Ponds (frogs, ducks), Forests (deer, birds)

Pollution: Cars, factories, trash and chemicals cause pollution

Plants: Leaves use sunlight for food and roots take in water

subjects.subject: Global Citizenship
subjects.infoText:
Empathy: The ability to share the feelings of another

Teamwork: Listen to everyone's ideas and share tasks fairly

Fairness: Take turns and share so everyone is equal

Responsibility: Take care of your chores and tasks

Solving Conflicts: Talk calmly and listen to each other
